group_intro: Group L is packed with history and emotion. England carry the usual pressure, Croatia bring recent World Cup pedigree, Ghana bring one of the most famous heartbreak stories in tournament history, and Panama arrive as a proud underdog.
beginner_hook: Watch this group if you like pressure, revenge stories, veteran magic, and underdogs trying to spoil big-name plans.
competitive_shape: England are the favorite because of their squad depth and attacking options. Croatia have the experience and tournament know-how to challenge them, Ghana can make games emotional and unpredictable, while Panama will try to turn discipline and fight into one famous result.
playstyle_theme: England bring power, pace, and control. Croatia rely on midfield intelligence and big-match calm. Ghana bring athleticism and direct attacking, while Panama play with fight, structure, and physical energy.
